scientific_findings.title: Very small practical effect
scientific_findings.statement: Mean gains are only 2.68e-5 to 5.30e-5 nats, or 0.00197% to 0.00389% of control NLL. Accuracy, calibration and heldout utility were not assessed.

scientific_findings.title: Three-block uncertainty and sensitivity
scientific_findings.statement: Full-node loses to common and permuted controls in seed29. All nominal three-IID-block paired t intervals include zero and are uncalibrated for shared-graph/overlapping-role/validation-selection dependence. Dropping seed17 reverses the common-control mean and the descriptive leave-one-out trigger.

scientific_findings.title: Selected states are very early
scientific_findings.statement: All arms select only continuation epoch4 for seed17 and epoch1 for seeds29/43. No later validation minimum appears before the prescribed patience stops; no frozen midpoint is reached. This does not establish longer-continuation benefit.

scientific_findings.title: Photo has frozen decisions but no executable paired source yet
scientific_findings.statement: The development gate is satisfied and Photo choices remain fixed. A sealed paired Photo driver and exact-global native qualification are still required; the gate does not establish Photo correspondence or quality.

evidence_limits: Model/logit/checkpoint arrays and original label packs were not opened or replayed.
Preservation and installed equality conclusions audit reported receipt certificates and source correspondence.
This review is a development study audit without heldout superiority or generalization evidence.
